fixes.explanation: Right, baker. God says, "And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times." (Exodus 25:30) Look at those two phrases, "before Me" and "…at all times." This bread isn't a one-time thing. It's meant to be there again and again. I know a little about being set in one spot for a long, long time, and I'm glad I got called out of that drawer.
